description: Variation of Condition F (restriction of operating hours) pursuant to planning permission dated 26/06/1978 ref 78/S/442 (Conversion of shop into a Restaurant) to allow opening hours of 24 hours 7 days a week (Temporary Permission).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - (a) Development commenced within 5 years of the date of the original planning permission (26.06.1978) (78/S/442).

Condition : 2 - (b) The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans, sections, elevations and particulars: (including materials to be used on all external faces). [Drawing Nos. 127.01, 127.02A, 127.02b, 127.06, 127.07, 127.07b and Cover Letter dated 02.09.2025 ref.L250902 - SAV Planning]

Condition : 3 - (c) Details of the flank elevations and the proposed finishes and windows on all elevations to be submitted for approval to the local planning authority before development takes place. [Details pursuant to condition C of planning permission dated 26.06.1978 (78/s/442) approved dated 07.11.1978 (ref.78/S/1050).]

Condition : 4 - (d) Details of the treatment of the open area at the rear of the site and car parking in the rear service area to be submitted for approval to the local planning authority before development takes place. [Details of new external brick finishes condition (d) of planning permission dated 26.06.78  (78/S/442) approved dated 05.01.1979 (ref.78/S/1162).]

Condition : 5 - (e) No loading or unloading of goods, including fuel, into or from vehicles arriving at or departing from the premises to which this permission relates shall be carried out otherwise than within the curtilage of these premises.

Condition : 6 - (f) The operating hours hereby approved shall be for a limited period of 12 months. This limited period must be commenced within three years of the date of this decision, and the applicant must provide the Local Planning Authority with written notification of the start and end date 10 days prior to first commencement. From the first day trading following the end of the limited period of 12 months, the opening hours shall revert back to 06:00 to 02:00 the following morning Sunday-Thursday, and 06:00 to 03:30 the following morning Friday-Saturday. 
Reason: To allow the local planning authority to review the impact of the extended hours on the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
